svg.title: USDE against ENA, daily moves and mNAV, June 26 to October 8, 2026
svg.desc: Left, 72 daily moves, ENA across and USDE up, correlation 0.64, fitted slope 1.37. The two axes use different scales. Right, mNAV at the 4 pm close, 0.37× on June 26, a low of 0.13× on July 24, a high of 0.52× on September 25 and 0.50× on October 8.
svg.text: USDE moved the same way as ENA on 50 of 72 days
Daily moves from one 4 pm New York close to the next, and mNAV at each close, June 26 to October 8, 2026.
